title: PICK AN ITEM, THEN PULL THE TRIGGER
why: His order of 2026-10-14: "You go to the wheel, you select one. Then you pull the trigger, and that lets you use the item. Then your gun comes back (have to come off trigger and then click it again to start firing). To get another one time use item, you have to go back to the wheel. That way players cant just spam grenades etc, takes a moment to pull them out." Picking an item on the wheel now takes it out: the gun is put away and the item needs a short moment to come out (a grenade 0.35 seconds, a bandage, medkit or plate 0.3, a stim 0.25). A fresh pull of the trigger then uses ONE of them: a grenade or smoke is cooked while you hold and thrown when you let go, a tripwire is placed the same way, a bandage or medkit starts applying (a bandage still stops at 85 health), a stim injects, and a plate slots. The gun then comes back by itself with its own draw time, and you have to let go of the trigger and pull it again before it fires. A second item means another trip to the wheel. A gun key, or opening the wheel again, puts the item away without using it, and a use that is refused (full health, full armour) puts it away and brings the gun back.
now: Pick an item on the wheel, pull the trigger to use one, and your gun comes back by itself.
